defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Use to fully immune a lethal hit or to drop a deadly debuff; Glacial Bulwark grants two charges, so script its usage across the fight's biggest damage events.

defensives.name: Ice Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep an absorb shield up before incoming damage and refresh it on cooldown; Glacial Bulwark grants two charges so you can pre-shield consecutive damage events.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a movement-friendly damage reduction when you need to keep dealing damage through a hit instead of going fully immune; talent-gated alternative to the standard Ice Block.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Activate before a burst of damage to snapshot your health and position, then let it return you to safety; talent-gated, so zero casts is normal if not taken.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Use to reduce incoming damage and pull threat off yourself during a dangerous window; talent-gated and not part of the standard damage rotation.
